audience: support and customer service teams reviewing conversations in Text Request

useCases.title: Triage unresolved conversations
useCases.text: Choose a texting dashboard, review unresolved conversations and read a contact’s message history before drafting a reply for review.

useCases.title: Check contact context before following up
useCases.text: Find a contact and review group and tag membership, blocked or suppressed state, and opt-out information before deciding on a follow-up.

useCases.title: Review scheduled reminders
useCases.text: Read scheduled one-to-one messages and inspect a selected message’s recipient and recurrence settings before reviewing the reminder wording.

useCases.title: Review recent messaging activity
useCases.text: Read dashboard message history within a UTC time range to summarize message direction, contact numbers and delivery states.
